title: Trust Him to Lead the Way
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler who takes the next step with unsure legs — trusting the One who knows the way when he cannot see the top of the hill.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because he trusts Heavenly Father even when he can’t see the whole way. In Beau’s world today: Beau’s family went on a hike, and the trail wound up a hill where Beau couldn’t see the top. His legs felt unsure. But Dad said, “Just take the next step — I know the way.” Beau trusted and kept going, and the view at the top was amazing! Just like Solomon said to trust Heavenly Father to direct our paths, Beau learned to trust the One who knows the way.
